responsibility: Contains the machine-description scheduling model for the Zhaoxin Yongfeng processor in GCC’s i386 backend. It defines Yongfeng-specific automata, decoder and execution-unit resources, AGU and divider units, and extensive `define_insn_reservation` latency/throughput rules for integer, memory, MMX, SSE, x87, and other instruction classes, so the scheduler can model this core’s decode width, port usage, and execution timing separately from the other Zhaoxin and AMD/Intel `.md` files.
